title: Apollo 17 insectoid metallic probe in lunar sky (unreleased)
summary: Maaneli Derakhshani tells of Apollo 17 insectoid metallic probe in lunar sky (unreleased), about 1972 at Lunar surface, Apollo 17, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: If you brighten the image a little bit, you see that it almost looks like an insecttoid type probe like metallic bluish metallic object.

plain: A guest on a podcast, Maaneli Derakhshani, says that among NASA's public photos from Apollo 17, the 1972 Moon mission flown by astronauts Eugene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt, there is an image with something in the lunar sky. He says that if you brighten the picture, it looks like an insect-shaped probe, a bluish metal object, which would suggest something artificial was near the astronauts on the Moon.
